scope: Synthetic Razor geometry/native controls plus separately executed bUnit event journeys; no hosted or physical-device inference.

journeys.steps: Open Todo, then Today, Habits, Dailies and Tasks; keep capture visible.
Enter a synthetic title; review exact required game intent; accept once; after lost acknowledgement recover the original receipt.
Edit planned date independently from deadline; review exact dates and project placement; reject invalid or stale data.
Complete an exact native task; find retained completion in History; restore only an eligible native Todo completion; preserve original receipt on uncertainty.
Open the complete schedule editor; review timezone and replacement rule; keep native occurrence actions distinct from Habitica schedules and penalties.
Open Projects; inspect exact task branch and optional metadata; review native changes without implying Habitica tag coverage.
Open Sync; inspect selected source and original command status; unknown or missing receipt never enables replay.
Open Diagnostics; preview the sanitized bundle before copy/download; unavailable storage remains explicit.
